A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''Jedi Master''' served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Jedi Civil War]] in [[3956 BBY]]. She was one of several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who accompanied Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Bastila Shan]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] ''[[Endar Spire]]'' when a [[Sith armada (Jedi Civil War)|Sith fleet]] [[Attack on the Endar Spire|ambushed]] and boarded the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] above the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. During the battle, she engaged a [[Unidentified Dark Jedi (Endar Spire)|Dark Jedi]] invader in a hallway aboard the vessel. She was able to defeat and [[Death/Legends|kill]] the man, but the wall behind her exploded moments later, killing her.

==Biography==
{{Quote|It's a Dark Jedi! This fight is too much for us&mdash;we better stay back. All we'd do is get in the way|Trask Ulgo, to Revan while watching the Jedi's duel|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
[[File:EndarSpireDuel.png|thumb|left|300px|The Jedi duels a Dark Jedi aboard the ''Endar Spire''.]]
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]<ref name="KOTOR" /> [[Gender/Legends|woman]]<ref name="Gender" /> was a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]<ref name="Guide">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> by [[3956 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]].<ref name="KOTOR" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> she accompanied [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Bastila Shan]] on the Republic [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] ''[[Endar Spire]],'' which was dispatched to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to defeat the [[Sith armada (Jedi Civil War)|Sith fleet]] preparing to invade the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. However, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Leviathan (Interdictor-class cruiser)|''Leviathan'']], was stationed [[Orbit/Legends|above]] Taris to [[Interdiction field/Legends|pull]] the ''Endar Spire'' out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The ''Endar Spire,'' whose crew was unaware of the flagship, fell prey to the subsequent [[Attack on the Endar Spire|ambush]] and was boarded by a Sith battle [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] led by [[Darth Bandon]], the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of the incumbent [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Darth Malak]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

During the attack, the Jedi encountered a [[Unidentified Dark Jedi (Endar Spire)|Dark Jedi]] who had boarded the ''Endar Spire'' and engaged them in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] as parts of the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] hallway exploded around her. [[Republic soldier]] [[Trask Ulgo]] and former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], whose memories had been [[Amnesia/Legends|erased]] and replaced with those of a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] loyal to the Republic, entered the hallway during the [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel's]] conclusion. Ulgo suggested to Revan that the two not get involved with the battle, believing they would only interfere with the Jedi's ability to win. After locking [[Lightsaber/Legends|blades]] several more times, the Jedi managed to hit the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], resulting in their [[Death/Legends|demise]]. Just as the fight ended, a section of the wall behind the Jedi exploded, killing her. Ulgo expressed frustration to Revan, saying that the Jedi would have been helpful during their escape from the ship.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Personality and traits==
The Jedi Master was a fair-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]] with [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and long black [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Powers and abilities==
The Jedi was adept enough in lightsaber combat to kill an invading Dark Jedi<ref name="KOTOR" /> while also possessing the knowledge and skills required to become a Jedi Master.<ref name="Guide" />

==Equipment==
As a member of the Jedi Order, the Jedi wielded a single-bladed blue lightsaber and wore standard beige and brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]]. She also wore a brown [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]], mauve [[Clothing/Legends|pants]], and brown [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] and [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. She wore her hair in a ponytail secured by a black cloth. At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of her death, she carried a [[vibration cell]] used to upgrade [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]] and an [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenal]] strength [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulant]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:EndarSpireJediAlt.png|thumb|right|250px|An alternate appearance of the Jedi]]
The Jedi Master first appeared as a non-playable character in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', a [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]]. The player encounters the Jedi in an unavoidable cutscene, during which she dies. The player may then pick up a vibration cell and a stimulant from her remains. No interactions with the Jedi progress quests or change alignment. Game files ''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'' describe the Jedi Master as a male [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

The Jedi shares her appearance with one of the possible choices for a female player character. Should the player choose that particular face during the initial part of the game, the Jedi Master's appearance will change accordingly, taking another of Revan's potential faces with green eyes and dark hair pulled into a long ponytail.<ref name="KOTOR" /> [[Canon]]ically, in regards to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, Revan is confirmed to be male by the [[2008]] ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]],<ref name="CG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> meaning the original appearance would be used. The face is reused throughout the game, and as such, the Jedi shares her appearance with several other non-playable characters.<ref name="KOTOR" />

''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'', published in 2003 by [[Prima Games]] and written from the perspective of Revan, stated that the woman was one of "your own Jedi Masters."<ref name="Guide" />
